sloka: न्यपतत् कुम्भकर्णो ऽथ स्वकायेन निपातयन्।प्लवङ्गमानां कोट्यश्च परितः सम्प्रधावताम् ।। ६.६७.१६० ।।
transliteration: nyapatat kumbhakarṇo 'tha svakāyena nipātayan।plavaṅgamānāṁ koṭyaśca paritaḥ sampradhāvatām ।। 6.67.160 ।।

translations.english: Then the remaining Vanaras who escaped killing and mutilation went close feeling desperate and witnessed the comb at between Rama and Kumbhakarna.
